dialog.title: Scan Library Folder
dialog.description: Recursively ingest movies and series from a filesystem path. TMDB metadata and matching .srt subtitles are imported automatically when available.

alert.title: Smart ingest with subtitle pairing
alert.description: The scanner auto-detects TMDB IDs in folder names, matches seasons/episodes, and links external .srt files that share the video basename. Use the category overrides below if you want movies or series to land in a custom section such as Kids or Anime.

form.attachSubtitlesHelp: Automatically import matching .srt files found alongside video files.
form.overrideMovieCategoryHelp: Pick an alternate category type for detected movies if needed.
